mercy_translation.text:
Who among the kings who ever lived reigned and won trophies over enemies before he was strong enough even to call father or mother? Did not David begin to reign at thirty years of age? Solomon reigned after he had become a young man. Joash came to the kingship at seven years old, and Josiah, still younger, took up rule at about seven years. Yet even at that age these could call father or mother.

Who, then, is the One who is king almost before birth and who despoils his enemies? Let the Jews search and tell us what king like this has arisen in Israel or Judah, upon whom all the nations have placed their hope and found peace. Were not the nations instead continually hostile to them from every side?

As long as Jerusalem stood, relentless war surrounded them and all fought against Israel: Assyrians oppressed them, Egyptians pursued them, Babylonians invaded them; and, remarkably, they even had the neighboring Syrians fighting against them. Did not David fight the Moabites and cut down Syrians? Did not Josiah guard himself from his neighbors, Hezekiah fear the arrogance of Sennacherib, Amalek attack Moses, the Amorites resist him, and the inhabitants of Jericho oppose Joshua son of Nun? In general, relations between the nations and Israel were without lasting peace. It is therefore worth seeing who this One is in whom the nations place their hope, for such a person must exist, since the prophet cannot lie.

Which of the holy prophets or ancient patriarchs died upon a cross for the salvation of all? Who was wounded and killed for the healing of all? Which righteous person or king went down into Egypt so that, by his descent, the idols of Egypt ceased? Abraham went down, and idolatry still remained everywhere. Moses was born there, and the worship of those in error continued no less.

translator_notes: Translated directly from the Greek source.
The chapter continues Athanasius' prophetic apologetic by contrasting Israel's historical rulers with the universal reign attributed to Christ.
Athanasius links the prophetic expectation of the nations with the peace and worship he sees spreading through Christianity.
